AccessResponse.description: The permissions the caller holds at some scope (display only: every call is still checked).

AdminInvitationResponse.description: `Invited` is false when the tenant already had an administrator, or on `Error`.

ChangeFieldLevels.description: Replaces a role's field levels (a field left out gets the catalogue default of a default role, its fallback otherwise).

ChangeRole.description: Replaces a custom role's name, description, permissions and field levels (a field left out gets its fallback).

ChangeSubscription.description: New terms for a subscription: plan by code (its newest version unless `PlanVersion` is given) and the rest in full.

CreateRole.description: A new custom role, from scratch or cloned from string? CreateRole.BasedOn (whose content fills what is left out).

EntitlementsResponse.description:
What the company may use now: plan, state, feature codes and limits (tenant-wide totals; a limit not listed is
unlimited). The apps show or lock features with it; the API checks every call.

FlagResponse.description:
A declared flag: its default, this environment's configured value and the platform-wide value (null when not set).
Company and user overrides come before these.

InvoiceResponse.description: An invoice Karry issued (decimal amount in its currency's minor units; negative for a credit note).

PermissionCatalogResponse.description: What roles can contain: every permission and sensitive field the modules declare.

PlanPriceDto.description: A price book line as the API writes it: `period` is `monthly` or `annual`.

PlanResponse.description: One plan version. `Limits`: a limit not listed is unlimited. `Prices`: empty for plans quoted by sales.

ProvisionTenant.description: A tenant to provision; `Admin` (optional) is invited by e-mail as first Tenant Admin (US-P1-TEN-01 AC1).

ProvisionedTenantResponse.description: The provisioned tenant; `AdminInvitation` is the outcome of the first administrator invitation when one was requested.

PublishPlan.description: A new version of a plan (or its first): the full content, nothing carried over implicitly.

RoleAssignment.description: A role held tenant-wide (Guid? RoleAssignment.SiteId null) or on one site (US-P1-IAM-03 AC1, US-P1-IAM-06).

RoleResponse.description: A role: default (name translated by the apps from the code) or custom; field levels of every declared field.

SubscriptionAction.description: An operator action on the state: `activate`, `missed-payment`, `payment` or `cancel`.

SubscriptionResponse.description:
A tenant's subscription. `Status`: trial, active, past_due, restricted, suspended, cancelled, expired,
deleted. `Period`: monthly or annual. Limits and features are resolved with the entitlements (slice 3).

TenantFlagResponse.description: A company override (`UserSubject` null) or a user's; `Enabled` null: removed.

UsageLineResponse.description: One metric: the live count, the tenant-wide limit and ceiling (null: unlimited), and its state.

UsageResponse.description:
The company's usage now. `State`: within, over (above the limit: banner, nothing blocked) or blocked (at the
ceiling, the limit plus its 10 % grace: no more creation; field capture never). `SnapshotOn`: the last daily
snapshot.
